app.name: Beacon Workshop
app.subtitle: The Lighthouse Town and Six Requests
banner.simulation: Practice screen — this is not the real Codex
banner.memory: Progress is not being saved on this device and will be lost when this tab closes. Export it from Settings.
banner.writeFailed: Progress is not being saved on this device (a write failed). Export it from Settings or try saving again.
banner.conflict: Another tab updated your progress. Saving from this tab is paused so it cannot overwrite the newer save.
banner.reloaded: Loaded the newer save from the other tab.
banner.blocked: To protect an unreadable save, progress in this tab is not being saved.
nav.label: Main menu
scene.label: Scene
title.lead: A story-driven learning adventure: help the people of Lumen harbor and practice requesting, building, fixing, checking and handing off work.
title.unofficial: An unofficial learning project, not affiliated with OpenAI.
title.simulation: The workshop and its results are prepared lesson material. Codex is never run.
title.free: The simulation is free and needs no login or API key.
title.local: Progress is stored only in this browser on this device.
start.title: Introduction
start.simBody: Practice building requests and making checks on the workshop's practice screens. The real Codex does not run. Mistakes never cost progress.
start.practiceBody: Cards for people who want to try the real Codex. Optional and self-reported. This app never connects to your PC or runs anything for you.
start.saveBody: Progress is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is never sent anywhere. Use Settings to export it to another device.
prologue.title: Lumen Harbor
map.title: Town map
map.sub: From the market to the lighthouse, one request at a time.
quest.notes: Current state of the notes app
quest.stale: Completed on an older lesson version
act.reviewing: Reviewing. Your completion record and XP will not change.
act.draftNote: Choices made before deciding are kept only in this tab and are lost when it closes.
hint.title: Hints
hint.note: Hints never reduce progress or XP. Seeing the example answer does not complete the exercise; you still make the choices on the board.
hint.allShown: All hints are shown. Go back to the board.
fb.correct: You can move on with this decision
fb.reviewNote: This was a review answer. Your first completion and XP are unchanged.
pb.howTo: Pick a card, then press "place here" on a section.
pb.nowSelected: Selected: "{card}". Choose where to place it. Press it again to deselect.
pb.missing: No cards placed yet. Pick a card and place it.
eb.poolEmpty: All candidates are in the steps.
eb.sequenceEmpty: No steps yet. Press "add to steps" on a candidate.
tr.missing: Some cases have no decision yet: {items}
panel.previewNote: Prepared lesson material, not a real execution result.
clear.title: {title} — Review
clear.lit: Light has returned to this district.
clear.hint3: Completed on the board after seeing the example answer
read.title: Read as a lesson
read.note: Every explanation and example answer is visible. Reading does not complete exercises or give XP (it is recorded separately as read).
read.toSimulation: Practice this chapter in the workshop
ending.title: The Lighthouse
ending.notYet: The ending is not open yet. Exercises {done}/{total}.
ending.practice: Real practice (self-checked): {n}/{total}. This is a separate, self-reported record.
ending.honest: This is a self-kept learning record. It is not a certification of Codex skill or an official certificate.
ending.futureNote: The next topics are not part of the first version yet; only their titles are listed.
pr.indexSub: Cards for trying things yourself in the real Codex. Optional.
pr.separate: Practice happens on your own PC in the official Codex app. This app never connects to your PC, never runs anything for you, and never asks for credentials.
pr.cardSub: This card has not been verified on a real device (draft). If the screen looks different, do not force it.
pr.copyFailed: Could not copy. The box below is selected; copy it manually.
pr.unavailableNote: That's fine. The simulation continues as usual. Do not switch to paid plans or other accounts for this.
pr.selfReport: This record is self-reported. The app does not verify it or certify it, and it adds no XP.
verify.source_checked: Sources checked (not verified on a device)
nb.title: Notebook
nb.empty: No cards yet. Your first three come from clearing Q01.
nb.secretWarning: Do not write passwords, API keys, personal information or private content in notes.
nb.notesNote: Notes stay on this device and are shown as plain text. Up to 500 characters per chapter and 3,000 in total.
nb.overLimit: This change exceeds the total limit ({max}) and was not saved.
gl.title: Glossary & sources
gl.sub: {n} terms for the first version, and the official materials referenced.
src.title: Sources
src.note: Links open an external site in a new tab. Your progress here is kept. Reachability checks are not device verification.
set.title: Settings & about
set.localeNote: English is in preparation. Untranslated parts are shown in Japanese. Changing language never changes progress.
set.sound: Sound: the first version has no sound.
save.title: Save data
save.where: Progress is stored only in this browser's localStorage (beacon-workshop.save.v1, plus the previous copy in beacon-workshop.backup.v1).
save.importNote: Only save files exported by this app (64 KiB or less) can be imported. You can review the content first.
save.importConfirm: This will replace your current progress. Confirm if this looks right.
save.importError.too_large: The file is too large (64 KiB max). Nothing was imported.
save.importError.bad_json: This could not be read as a save file. Nothing was imported.
save.importError.unsupported_version: This save is from a newer version of the app. To protect your progress, nothing was imported.
save.importError.invalid: The save file contains fields that cannot be read. Nothing was imported.
save.importError.not_object: This is not a save file. Nothing was imported.
save.resetNote: Erases progress, notes and practice records. Export first if you may want them back.
save.resetConfirm: Really erase your progress? This cannot be undone (an exported file can be imported).
about.title: About
about.noNetwork: No learning data is sent anywhere. No ads, analytics or external AI calls.
about.art: Images are placeholders and will be replaced later.
about.license: The license will be decided before publication.
rc.title: Save recovery
rc.corrupt: The save data is damaged and could not be read. It has not been deleted.
rc.unsupported: Found save data from a newer version (schemaVersion {v}). It has not been deleted.
rc.kept: Nothing is written to the save until you choose what to do.
rc.export: Export the unreadable data to a file
rc.noBackup: There is no previous copy to restore.
rc.startOverConfirm: Delete the unreadable save and start over? Exporting it first is recommended.
rc.restored: Progress restored from the previous copy.
guard.questLocked: "{title}" is not open yet. It opens after the previous request.
guard.activityLocked: This exercise opens after the previous one.
guard.notCleared: This chapter still has exercises left.
guard.unknownUrl: That page was not found. You are back on the map.
